params.name: delimiter
params.reason: Groups deeper object names into prefixes.

params.name: endOffset
params.reason: Restricts names to those before this boundary.

params.name: includeFoldersAsPrefixes
params.reason: Adds folders and managed folders to returned prefixes.

params.name: includeTrailingDelimiter
params.reason: Adds trailing-delimiter objects to the items.

params.name: matchGlob
params.reason: Restricts results to names matching the glob.

params.name: prefix
params.reason: Restricts results to names beginning with this prefix.

params.name: projection
params.reason: Controls which properties each object returns.

params.name: startOffset
params.reason: Restricts names to those at or after this boundary.

params.name: userProject
params.reason: Specifies the project billed for the request.

params.name: versions
params.reason: Includes all object versions as distinct results.

reason: Classified each parameter by whether it filters listed results, changes response content, or serves a request-level purpose.
